subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: After the typecheck repair, should OpenClaw accept this PR's combination of embedded prompt-lock retry suppression, orchestrator-level connection/timeout retry restoration, and takeover resend guidance as the permanent fix for the linked silent-message-loss bug?
rationale: The remaining code direction changes retry timing, session-state ownership, and user-visible message-delivery semantics; automation can fix the mock but cannot own that merge-risk decision.

options.title: Accept after mock repair
options.body: Fix the test mock, require focused validation to pass, then proceed with normal owner review of the retry and takeover behavior.

options.title: Request narrower retry behavior
options.body: Ask the author to keep the takeover resend/fence fix but remove or redesign the orchestrator-level connection/timeout retry restoration before merge.

options.title: Hold for broader session redesign
options.body: Pause this PR and route the linked issue to a larger session-lock recovery design if maintainers do not want this layered mitigation.

recommendation.title: Accept after mock repair
recommendation.body: Fix the test mock, require focused validation to pass, then proceed with normal owner review of the retry and takeover behavior.
